paragraph: Angola [signed a memorandum of understanding with Mozambique in June 2026](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/6025/angola-and-mozambique-sign-space-and-digital-cooperation-agreements-to-strengthen-connectivity>) on communications, information technology, information and meteorology. In the last twelve months it also [hosted in Luanda the third preparatory meeting of the Southern African Development Community for the 2027 World Radiocommunication Conference](<https://angop.ao/en/noticias/sociedade/sadc-harmoniza-posicao-para-conferencia-mundial-de-radio/>) in August 2026. In October 2026 it [hosted the seventh SADC Cyber Drill in Luanda, from 5 to 9 October](<https://www.sadc.int/latest-news/sadc-strengthens-regional-cybersecurity-and-cybercrime-cooperation>). No source found says anything Angola agreed has been put into effect. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

Burundi [entered the East African Community One Network Area on 1 August 2024](<https://www.burunditimes.com/burundi-embraces-eac-digital-integration-for-ict-growth/>). Its regulator's rules cut regional roaming tariffs. The regional regulators' organisation reports that [inbound cross-border voice traffic rose 126 per cent in 2025](<https://admin.eaco.int/assets/e774142a-21fd-48e2-bdfd-3309d7d559d7?download=EACO%20Regional%20Communications%20Sector%20Statistics%20Report%202025.pdf>), from 89.6 million to 202.9 million minutes. In the last twelve months Burundi [took part in the Community's Digital for Development Forum in Arusha in June 2026](<https://web.archive.org/web/20260809110204/https://finances.gov.bi/index.php/2026/06/26/le-burundi-prend-part-a-la-construction-du-marche-unique-numerique-de-lafrique-de-lest/>). In November 2026 an East African Community official [named Burundi among six of eight partner states that have put the roaming framework into effect](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-11-03-eac-moves-to-slash-cross-border-call-data-charges>). Its telecoms regulator also [took part in an East African Communications Organisation working group in Juba from 23 November 2026](<https://cajnewsafrica.com/2026/11/24/east-africa-aligns-cross-border-policies-on-digital-connectivity/>).

[Free roaming with Togo took effect on 1 January 2024](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/2610-60121-west-africa-struggles-to-deliver-free-roaming-nearly-nine-years-after-regional-agreement>), and [free roaming with Ghana was launched on 9 October 2024](<https://nca.org.gh/2024/10/09/ghana-kicks-off-ecowas-free-roaming-with-togo-and-benin/>). In March 2025 Togolese consumer associations [tested it in Cotonou and Porto-Novo](<https://www.republiquetogolaise.tg/telecoms/2804-10595-free-roaming-entre-le-togo-et-ses-voisins-des-performances-enregistrees>). Every test call from Togo's two networks went through, while tariffs, billing and mobile data fell short. In the last twelve months, free roaming with Senegal and Togo together [began in Lome on 24 April 2026](<https://arcep.bj/lancement-officiel-du-free-roaming-entre-le-benin-le-senegal-et-le-togo/>). No source found gives figures of roaming traffic.

Burkina Faso's regulator [signed a free roaming memorandum with those of Mali and Niger in Niamey in November 2024](<https://www.lesahel.org/integration-numerique-larcep-niger-celebre-son-25e-anniversaire-avec-la-signature-dun-memorandum-dentente-sur-le-free-roaming-entre-les-pays-membres-de-l/>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026, it [signed a convention with Mali and Niger creating the Council of Sahel Regulators](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article149528>). On 25 September 2026 Niger's regulator head, in Ouagadougou, [said free roaming among the three Sahel states was already working](<https://www.radarsburkina.net/index.php/fr/politique/4017-cooperation-numerique-dans-l-aes-les-regulateurs-passent-de-la-coordination-a-l-action>). No source gives figures of its use or a decision of the regulators' council. Mature would need figures of its use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what it delivered.

[Reduced roaming rates between Botswana and Namibia took effect in August 2024](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/03/13/botswana-and-five-sadc-countries-slash-roaming-tariffs-under-one-network-area-framework/>). In the last twelve months, in March 2026, [Botswana's operators applied the new One Network Area roaming tariffs](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/03/13/botswana-and-five-sadc-countries-slash-roaming-tariffs-under-one-network-area-framework/>), with cuts of 10 to 98.6 per cent. Its communications minister also [signed a cooperation memorandum with Namibia in Kasane on 7 August 2026](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/6641/namibia-and-botswana-sign-ict-cooperation-agreement>). No source from the last three years gives figures of use or a joint body's decision. Mature would need figures of use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what was delivered.

The Central African Republic [joined the Smart Africa Trust Alliance in May 2024](<https://techafricanews.com/2024/05/31/comoros-and-central-african-republic-join-smart-africa-trust-alliance-for-enhanced-connectivity/>). It is [listed among the 49 signatories of the Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence of April 2025](<https://c4ir.rw/docs/Africa-Declaration-on-Artificial-Intelligence.pdf>). In the last twelve months Smart Africa [welcomed it as a member in March 2026](<https://smartafrica.org/zimbabwe-elected-chair-of-cmict-as-smart-africa-welcomes-new-member-states/>). No source found dates an agreement signed, a meeting hosted or chaired, or a seat won in the last three years. Establishing would need an agreement signed, a meeting hosted or chaired, or a seat won.

Its regulator says [free roaming with Ghana, launched on 14 June 2023, cut charges for Ivorian subscribers in Ghana by as much as 90 per cent](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/2610-60121-west-africa-struggles-to-deliver-free-roaming-nearly-nine-years-after-regional-agreement>). In the last twelve months Cote d'Ivoire [signed a roaming agreement with Burkina Faso in Ouagadougou on 23 October 2026](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/2610-60121-west-africa-struggles-to-deliver-free-roaming-nearly-nine-years-after-regional-agreement>). In September 2026 it [hosted in Abidjan the fourth and last African preparatory meeting of the African Telecommunications Union for the 2026 ITU Plenipotentiary Conference](<https://afriksoir.net/telecommunications-la-4%e1%b5%89-et-derniere-reunion-preparatoire-africaine-avant-la-pp-26-de-doha-sest-ouverte-a-abidjan/>). No source found gives figures of the roaming's use. Mature would need figures of its use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what it delivered.

[In April 2024 ARTAC counted two live free roaming links between Central African operators](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1606-139332-cemac-les-operateurs-recalcitrants-au-free-roaming-menaces-de-mise-en-demeure>), out of 213 planned. [Both involved Cameroon: MTN Cameroon with MTN Congo, and Orange Cameroun with Airtel Gabon](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1606-139332-cemac-les-operateurs-recalcitrants-au-free-roaming-menaces-de-mise-en-demeure>). In the last twelve months, on 20 and 21 October 2026, the Central African telecoms regulators [fixed the headquarters of their assembly, ARTAC, in Cameroon](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/7974/cameroon-to-host-artac-headquarters-as-central-african-regulators-deepen-digital-coo>). No source found gives figures of roaming use or a review of it. Mature would need figures of its use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what it delivered.

The Democratic Republic of the Congo [hosted in Kinshasa in February 2026 the tenth ordinary session of ARTAC](<https://art.cm/en/node/246964>), the Central African telecoms regulators' assembly. At its opening [its regulator signed a roaming agreement with Gabon's](<https://art.cm/en/node/246964>). [The roaming agreement with Gabon was to take effect on 30 June 2026](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/2502-53256-gabon-drc-to-scrap-cross-border-roaming-charges-from-june-2026>). In the last twelve months the African Telecommunications Union's conference also [validated the move of its headquarters from Nairobi to Kinshasa on 23 July 2026](<https://thepanafricanpress.info/one-year-of-suminwa-ii-jose-mpandas-telecom-milestones-in-the-drc/>). No source found says the roaming agreement has been put into effect. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

[Free roaming with Gabon went into service for voice on 15 October 2019](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-T/Workshops-and-Seminars/2025/0217/Documents/01-Rene%cc%81-Pierre%20Favre.pdf>), and later took in text messages and data. Congo's regulator [publishes monthly Congo-Gabon roaming call counts from January 2020 to December 2024](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-T/Workshops-and-Seminars/2025/0217/Documents/02-Mireille%20Koumous.pdf>). [December 2024 had 81,563 calls](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-T/Workshops-and-Seminars/2025/0217/Documents/02-Mireille%20Koumous.pdf>). In the last twelve months the Republic of the Congo [was elected to the 25-member council of the African Telecommunications Union on 24 July 2026](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/07/27/atu-conference-adopts-abuja-declaration-to-advance-meaningful-connectivity-across-africa/>). [Brazzaville hosted the CEMAC council of ministers on 13 June 2026](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1606-139332-cemac-les-operateurs-recalcitrants-au-free-roaming-menaces-de-mise-en-demeure>).

In July 2025 the regulator ANRTIC [reported cooperation agreements with four other regulators](<https://www.itu.int/itu-d/meetings/gsr-25/wp-content/uploads/sites/33/2025/07/GSR-25_Contribution_Best-practice-Guidelines_ANRTIC-Comoros2_E.pdf>), those of Madagascar, Senegal, Morocco and Mauritius. No signing dates are given. In the last twelve months delegates from Comoros [took part in a SADC workshop on data governance in Harare in August 2026](<https://itweb.africa/article/sadc-puts-spotlight-on-ai-data-governance/JN1gP7OAw5wqjL6m>). On 24 July 2026 the African Union's development agency [launched a programme for island economies](<https://www.nepad.org/news/auda-nepad-launches-first-continental-programme-dedicated-africas-island-economies>) that names Comoros. No source found says anything Comoros agreed has been put into effect. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

In November 2024 Praia [hosted the sixteenth meeting of the West African regulators' focal points on regional roaming](<https://www.ecowas.int/16th-meeting-of-focal-points-of-ecowas-national-regulatory-authorities-on-the-implementation-of-regional-roaming-concludes-in-praia-cabo-verde/>). ECOWAS reported that [Cabo Verde's mobile operators offer roaming at the tariffs the regional roaming regulation sets](<https://www.ecowas.int/16th-meeting-of-focal-points-of-ecowas-national-regulatory-authorities-on-the-implementation-of-regional-roaming-concludes-in-praia-cabo-verde/>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026, Cabo Verde's data protection authority [sat on the fifth board of the Network of African Data Protection Authorities](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/tsitsi-mariwo_dataprotection-togetherwecandomore-activity-7501689491284320257-D6sq>). No source found gives figures of roaming use. Mature would need figures of its use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what it delivered.

Djibouti [joined the Eastern Africa regional digital integration project](<https://www.lanation.dj/transition-numerique-les-parties-prenantes-mobilisees-autour-des-projets-dfn-et-eardip/>), which is to lay terrestrial fibre along the northern road corridor. In the last twelve months it [hosted the sixteenth African Union Private Sector Forum on 8 to 10 December 2025](<https://au.int/en/pressreleases/20251211/16th-psf-concluded-strong-assertion-digital-economy-transformation>). Its officials [attended the East Africa regional data governance workshop in Nairobi in June 2026](<https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/strengthening-data-governance-east-africa-regional-workshop-concludes-nairobi>). The fibre is not reported as built or lit. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

Algeria and Tunisia have a standing joint technical commission on communications. [Its fourth session in June 2026](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/06/09/algeria-and-tunisia-expand-cooperation-in-telecommunications-and-ict-sector/>) agreed joint projects, and none is reported as started. In the last twelve months, on 6 to 8 December 2025, African ministers meeting in Algiers [adopted the Algiers Declaration on fair, safe and responsible digital platforms](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites/1112-134196-declaration-d-alger-l-afrique-ebauche-une-regulation-commune-pour-facebook-x-tik-tok-spotify-netflix>). No source from the last three years gives figures of use or a joint body's decision. Mature would need figures of use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what was delivered.

Egypt's assistant foreign minister for African affairs [said on 22 September 2026 that Egypt contributed to developing the African Union's continental artificial intelligence strategy](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/3/1239/577214/Business/Tech/Egypt-seeks-to-expand-technology-diplomacy,-deepen.aspx>), and that Egypt continues to work on it. That statement was made in the last twelve months. Nothing Egypt has done at home under the strategy is reported. No agreement signed, meeting hosted or chaired, or seat won in the last three years has been found. Establishing would need an agreement signed, a meeting hosted or chaired, or a seat won.

In the last twelve months, on 27 April 2026, Ethiopia's national identity programme [signed a three-year memorandum of understanding on digital identity](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202604/mozambique-taps-ethiopias-digital-id-expertise-in-dpi-partnership>) with Mozambique's digital transformation agency. In September 2026 Ethiopia [sent representatives to the East African regional digital integration workshop in Nairobi](<https://www.eac.int/eadrip-news-updates/eardip-press-releases/3596-eac,-igad-and-eastern-african-countries-unite-to-accelerate-regional-digital-integration-and-connectivity>). No identity service or exchange is reported as started under the memorandum. No source found says anything Ethiopia agreed has been put into effect. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

ARCEP says Gabon [has opened free roaming with Rwanda, Congo, Togo and Cameroon](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-T/Workshops-and-Seminars/2025/0217/Documents/01-Rene%cc%81-Pierre%20Favre.pdf>), as of February 2025. In the last twelve months, in February 2026, it [signed a roaming agreement with the Congolese regulator at ARTAC's session in Kinshasa](<https://art.cm/en/node/246964>). [It removes roaming charges between Gabon and the DRC from 30 June 2026](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/2502-53256-gabon-drc-to-scrap-cross-border-roaming-charges-from-june-2026>). In October 2026 [Gabon was elected third vice-chair of its bureau](<http://www.au.int/en/pressreleases/20261027/au-opens-6th-session-specialized-technical-committee-communication-and-ict>) at the African Union's technical committee on communication and ICT in Libreville. No source found gives figures of roaming use. Mature would need figures of use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what was delivered.

[Free roaming between Benin and Ghana took effect on 1 July 2024](<https://www.connectingafrica.com/connectivity/ghana-burkina-faso-tackle-cross-border-signal-interference>). In the last twelve months Ghana [concluded its agreement with Liberia in May 2026](<https://www.thenewdawnliberia.com/liberia-launches-free-roaming-service-with-ghana-sierra-leone-and-the-gambia/>), and Liberian subscribers have roamed in Ghana without charges since 17 July 2026. Ghana's minister [took the chair of the African Union's ICT committee on 29 October 2026](<https://au.int/en/speeches/20261029/auc-commissioner-6th-au-stc-communication-and-ict-stc-cict>). No source found gives figures of roaming use. Mature would need figures of use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what was delivered.

Guinea [hosted the seventh Transform Africa Summit of the Smart Africa Alliance in Conakry in November 2025](<https://smartafrica.org/transform-africa-summit-2025-conakry-becomes-the-epicenter-of-digital-cooperation-in-africa>). There [Sierra Leone's regulator and Guinea signed a protocol introducing free mobile roaming between the two countries](<https://natca.gov.sl/2025/11/17/the-republic-of-sierra-leone-signs-free-roaming-agreement-with-republic-of-guinea-to-ease-cross-border-connectivity/>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026, [a regional platform of regulators that Guinea's audiovisual regulator belongs to issued a communique with Niger's regulator](<https://guineenews.org/2026/09/26/pra-uemoa-guinee-la-hac-et-lonc-niger-passent-aux-actes-avec-plusieurs-resolutions/>). Free roaming with Sierra Leone is not reported as started. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

[Free roaming between Senegal and The Gambia was introduced in December 2025](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/6078/senegal-and-the-gambia-enhance-digital-integration-through-regulatory-cooperation-agreement>), with calls received free and made at local rates for up to 30 days. In the last twelve months The Gambia and Senegal [signed a memorandum of understanding on telecommunications, information technology and the digital economy in Dakar on 12 June 2026](<https://gambiaj.com/economy/policy/gambia-senegal-move-to-implement-digital-cooperation-agreement/>). The first steering committee under it met in Banjul in August 2026 to set a roadmap. No source found gives figures of roaming use. Mature would need figures of use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what was delivered.

ECOWAS [names Guinea-Bissau among the countries carrying out the West Africa regional digital integration programme](<https://www.ecowas.int/ecowas-participation-in-the-digital-transformation-for-africa-western-africa-regional-digital-integration-program-declared-effective/>), declared effective in March 2024. In the last twelve months its regulators and policymakers [took part in a data governance workshop for Portuguese-speaking African countries in December 2025](<https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/lusophone-countries-africa-deepen-digital-cooperation-strengthen-data-governance>). On 16 October 2026 the African Telecommunications Union [reported the country among 23 states that have endorsed the 49 African Common Proposals](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/7771/atu-secures-endorsements-for-49-african-proposals-ahead-of-itu-plenipotentiary-conference>). No agreement signed, meeting hosted or chaired, or seat won in the last three years is recorded. Establishing would need an agreement signed, a meeting hosted or chaired, or a seat won.

Equatorial Guinea is [listed among the 49 countries that signed the Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence at Kigali on 4 April 2025](<https://c4ir.rw/docs/Africa-Declaration-on-Artificial-Intelligence.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, it [held the rotating presidency of ECCAS, the Economic Community of Central African States](<https://www.uneca.org/stories/eccas-validates-regional-data-governance-framework-to-advance-digital-integration-in-central>). The Statistical Commission for Africa [elected Equatorial Guinea to chair it for 2026 to 2028](<https://inege.org/?lang=fr&p=18389>) at its tenth session in Addis Ababa. No source found says anything Equatorial Guinea agreed has been put into effect. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

The regional regulators' organisation [publishes Kenya's One Network Area cross-border voice figures for 2025](<https://admin.eaco.int/assets/e774142a-21fd-48e2-bdfd-3309d7d559d7?download=EACO%20Regional%20Communications%20Sector%20Statistics%20Report%202025.pdf>). Inbound calls ran to 461.5 million minutes, up 19.2 per cent, and outbound to 603.5 million. In the last twelve months Kenya's central bank [signed a memorandum with Rwanda's in March 2026](<https://www.bis.org/speeches/20260313-signing-mou-between-central-bank-kenya-and-national-bank-rwanda>). It lets payment providers licensed in one state operate in the other. In November 2026 an East African Community official [named Kenya among six of eight partner states that have put the roaming framework into effect](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-11-03-eac-moves-to-slash-cross-border-call-data-charges>).

[Free roaming between Liberia and Sierra Leone took effect in August 2025](<https://lta.gov.lr/liberia-and-sierra-leone-roll-out-free-roaming-agreement/>), with calls at local rates across the border. In the last twelve months, in Accra on 30 April 2026, Liberia [signed free roaming memoranda with Ghana and Sierra Leone](<https://nca.org.gh/2026/05/05/tripartite-ecowas-roaming-meeting-concludes-with-key-commitments-to-seamless-regional-connectivity/>). On 17 July 2026 its regulator [launched free roaming with Ghana, Sierra Leone and The Gambia](<https://www.thenewdawnliberia.com/liberia-launches-free-roaming-service-with-ghana-sierra-leone-and-the-gambia/>). No source found gives figures of its use. Mature would need figures of use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what was delivered.

Libya's General Authority for Communications and Informatics [sent a delegation to the seventh plenipotentiary conference of the African Telecommunications Union](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=362348&lang=en>). The conference was held in Abuja in July 2026, within the last twelve months. Attending a meeting is not an agreement signed or a seat won. No agreement signed, meeting hosted or chaired, or seat won in the last three years has been found. Establishing would need an agreement signed, a meeting hosted or chaired, or a seat won.

Botswana's regulator says [Lesotho's mobile operators cut roaming prices for data, voice and SMS by 10 to 98.6% under southern Africa's One Network Area](<https://theafricanmirror.africa/news/cheaper-cross-border-call-rates-beckon-on-lower-tariffs-push/>), reported in March 2026. In the last twelve months Lesotho's minister [chaired the African Union's ICT committee until 29 October 2026](<https://au.int/en/speeches/20261029/auc-commissioner-6th-au-stc-communication-and-ict-stc-cict>). Lesotho also [held a validation workshop in Maseru](<https://lestimes.com/?p=91596>) on Smart Africa's national data blueprint. No figures of roaming use have been found. Mature would need figures of use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what was delivered.

Morocco is [one of three pilot countries for the continental free trade area's cross-border data exchange system, announced in May 2026](<https://data-landscapers.com/2026/05/28/building-same-road-twice/>). The pilot is not reported as running. In the last twelve months Morocco [was elected to the administrative council of the African Telecommunications Union for 2027 to 2031 in July 2026](<https://www.mmsp.gov.ma/fr/actualites/le-royaume-du-maroc-%C3%A9lu-membre-au-conseil-administratif-de-lunion-africaine-des-t%C3%A9l%C3%A9communications-pour-la-p%C3%A9riode-2027-2031>). [Morocco holds the permanent secretariat of the African Network of Data Protection Authorities, whose new bureau first met in Rabat in September 2026](<https://fr.al3omk.com/44902.html>). No source found says anything Morocco agreed has been put into effect. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

Madagascar [joined the Smart Africa Trust Alliance at Barcelona in February 2024](<https://www.lexpress.mg/2024/02/mwc-24-barcelone-madagascar-rejoint.html>), its digital minister signing the accession. In the last twelve months a delegation [attended the Southern African Development Community's public service assembly in August 2026](<https://moov.mg/article/120425-fonction-publique-madagascar-defend-une-administration-tournee-vers-les-citoyens-a-la-sadc>). Beyond that accession, no agreement signed, meeting hosted or chaired, or seat won in the last three years is recorded. Establishing would need an agreement signed, a meeting hosted or chaired, or a seat won.

In November 2024 Mali's regulator [signed a free roaming memorandum with those of Burkina Faso and Niger in Niamey](<https://www.lesahel.org/integration-numerique-larcep-niger-celebre-son-25e-anniversaire-avec-la-signature-dun-memorandum-dentente-sur-le-free-roaming-entre-les-pays-membres-de-l/>). In the last twelve months it [signed a convention with the regulators of Burkina Faso and Niger](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article149528>), reported in September 2026. On 25 September 2026 Niger's regulator [said free roaming among Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger was already working](<https://www.radarsburkina.net/index.php/fr/politique/4017-cooperation-numerique-dans-l-aes-les-regulateurs-passent-de-la-coordination-a-l-action>). The council the convention created is not reported meeting. No figures of roaming use have been found. Mature would need figures of use, a joint body's decision, or a review of what was delivered.

Mozambique and Angola [signed a memorandum on communications and information technology in June 2026](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/6025/angola-and-mozambique-sign-space-and-digital-cooperation-agreements-to-strengthen-connectivity>). It provides for technical cooperation and exchanges. In the last twelve months Mozambique's customs and those of four neighbours [adopted a plan for customs data exchange on 26 August 2026](<https://southernafricantimes.com/five-southern-african-countries-move-to-link-customs-data-as-trade-corridors-face-pressure-to-cut-delays/>). [On 12 October 2026 INTIC was elected to the ANCA-CERT committee for southern Africa](<https://intic.gov.mz/mocambique-eleito-para-o-comite-de-gestao-da-anca-cert-em-representacao-da-africa-austral/>). Nothing is reported as started under the memorandum. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.

In the last twelve months Mauritania's data protection authority and Morocco's data protection commission [signed a cooperation convention in Marrakech in January 2026](<https://panorapost.ma/post.php?id=53790>). It provides for exchanges of expertise and experience, and none is reported as having taken place. In April 2026 Mauritania [was among the states at the general assembly of the West African telecommunications regulators' association in Lome](<https://lanation.bj/numerique/telecommunications-le-benin-le-senegal-et-le-togo-lancent-un-roaming-sans-frontieres>). No source found says anything Mauritania agreed has been put into effect. Operating would need something agreed put into effect.
